paths.name: Semiconductor Technician Quick Start
paths.format: 10 days (4 hours per day), in-person
paths.note: Accelerated entry-level semiconductor technician training; $306 tuition stipend fully covers Arizona-resident tuition on completion and passing the NIMS certification.

paths.name: Technician Apprenticeship Program
paths.format: Registered apprenticeship, paid hourly: 12-18 months for equipment/process tracks (a 36-48-month track is also listed)
paths.note: On-the-job training at TSMC AZ plus related technical instruction via Estrella Mountain CC, Rio Salado College and Northern Arizona University; requires 18+ and high school diploma/GED.

paths.name: Work-study (BBL & duaal leerwerk) at ASML
paths.format: 2-3 year mbo (BBL) or 4-year hbo work-study; 4 days work + 1 day school; salary EUR 2,549-2,800, tuition paid
paths.note: Earn an officially recognised mbo or hbo diploma while working in ASML's Veldhoven cleanrooms, with the prospect of a permanent contract.

paths.name: Eerste Monteur Mechatronica bij ASML (First Mechanic Mechatronics, MBO level 3)
paths.format: MBO level 3 work-based learning: 3 shift days at ASML + 1 day at Summa; EUR 2,549-2,800 gross/month, tuition reimbursed; 18+
paths.note: Free vocational mechatronics programme with work in ASML cleanrooms in Veldhoven, starting September 2026.

paths.name: Customer Support engineering careers and training centers
paths.format: On-the-job training plus months at ASML training centers (Taiwan, South Korea, Netherlands); 2+ year engineering development program in the US
paths.note: Customer support engineers install and keep lithography systems running in customer fabs; open to early-career, industry specialists and veterans with transferrable skills.

paths.name: Microelectronics Technology (MT) AAS
paths.format: 2-year associate degree
paths.note: Trains semiconductor technicians; page cites graduate starting salaries of $56,000-$65,000 and paid part-time internships with Intel, Lam Research and others.

paths.name: Electrical Technology: Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology A.A.S.
paths.format: A.A.S. degree
paths.note: Prepares students for semiconductor fabrication, MEMS and nanotechnology with classroom and hands-on instruction (Capital Region / GlobalFoundries area).

paths.name: Semiconductor Technology Certificate
paths.format: Certificate; suited to students with some college credit in physics, math, electricity and electronics
paths.note: Specialised training in semiconductor and nanotechnology, electro-mechanical devices, semiconductor manufacturing and nanofabrication for entry-level processor/technician roles.

paths.name: Semiconductor careers pathway (Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology)
paths.format: Associate degree (Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology)
paths.note: Automation and process-control training approved as an education option for semiconductor jobs at Intel's Ohio fab and other chipmakers.

paths.name: Semiconductor Cleanroom Certificate
paths.format: Short-term or one-year certificate, stackable toward an AAS
paths.note: Electrical/electronic fundamentals with a semiconductor focus for entry-level technician roles, including with Intel.

paths.name: Mikrotechnologe/Mikrotechnologin Schwerpunkt Halbleitertechnik
paths.format: Dual vocational training (Duale Berufsausbildung, 3-3.5 years); no formal entry requirements beyond compulsory schooling
paths.note: Official qualification profile for the German microtechnologist apprenticeship specialising in semiconductor technology; contract is with a training company.

paths.name: imec.academy
paths.note: imec's learning institute offering specialised courses on nanoelectronics and advanced semiconductor process technology with hands-on technical training.

paths.name: ECSA E-Learning course list
paths.provider: European Chips Skills Academy (SEMI Europe, EU-funded)
paths.format: E-learning courses from beginner level; account required
paths.note: EU-funded catalogue of microelectronics and semiconductor e-learning courses.

paths.name: Master's in Microelectronics and Semiconductors (online)
paths.format: Online master's, 30 credit hours
paths.note: Part of Purdue's Semiconductor Degrees Program, drawing on materials, ECE, business and polytechnic schools.

paths.name: Semiconductor Processing (Graduate Certificate)
paths.format: Graduate certificate, 15 credit hours, available online
paths.note: Courses in semiconductor processing, packaging and characterisation for careers at device makers and equipment manufacturers.

paths.name: Global Undergraduate Program in Semiconductors (English-taught)
paths.format: 4 years; tuition NTD 60,000 (USD 2,000) per semester
paths.note: Fully English-taught semiconductor bachelor's with thematic research and industry internship courses.

paths.name: College of Semiconductor Research (Master's and Ph.D.)
paths.format: Master's and Ph.D. admissions
paths.note: Graduate college in Hsinchu covering semiconductor devices, design, process and materials, with industry partners.

paths.name: 半導體與AI應用專業人才養成班 (Semiconductor & AI Application Talent Training Class)
paths.provider: Ministry of Labor x National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
paths.format: 231 training hours; remote or in-person; cohorts with application deadlines through late 2026
paths.note: Labor-ministry-backed training for employed and unemployed people, with job counselling and employer matching into semiconductor, optoelectronics and data roles.

paths.name: Semiconductor Convergence Campus (반도체융합캠퍼스)
paths.format: 2-year degree programmes; state-funded free vocational training courses; Hi-Tech course for college graduates
paths.note: Departments in semiconductor process equipment, equipment development/software, measurement, test and packaging; runs re-employment courses incl. for middle-aged and women returners.

paths.name: Semiconductor Device Program (Faculty of Engineering) and DS Semiconductor Course
paths.format: Undergraduate programmes (from April 2024)
paths.note: Japan's first bachelor's course dedicated to semiconductor engineers; the data-science track also admits humanities-stream students to learn semiconductor manufacturing.

paths.name: Semiconductor Maintenance Technician - Technical Certificate
paths.format: Technical certificate
paths.note: Hands-on training in mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic and vacuum systems used in chip-fabrication equipment.

paths.name: Semiconductor Maintenance Technician (SMT.S.CRT)
paths.format: Certificate, 37 credit hours
paths.note: Installing, maintaining and troubleshooting industrial machinery incl. semiconductor fab tools; includes vacuum system technology.

paths.name: Semiconductor Cleanroom Maintenance Technology
paths.format: One-year technical certificate
paths.note: Prepares entry-level cleanroom maintenance technicians for semiconductor manufacturing.

paths.name: IBEW/NECA Joint Apprenticeship (JATC/AJATC) - Outside Lineman, Inside Wireman, VDV, Residential
paths.format: On-the-job training plus classroom training; apply to local JATC
paths.note: Union apprenticeships for outside linemen (transmission/distribution lines) and inside wiremen (power, controls in commercial/industrial buildings).

paths.name: Electrical Lineworker Program (ELP)
paths.format: 15-week pre-apprentice program; Class A CDL required
paths.note: Climbing, overhead and underground distribution, transmission, equipment, CDL and crane training at campuses in ID, CA, TX and FL.

paths.name: Electrical Lineworker
paths.format: 8 weeks; 18+, high school diploma/GED, valid driver's license; mandatory 4-hour orientation
paths.note: Trains entry-level line workers for public and private utilities: pole climbing, bucket trucks, power line installation and repair.

paths.name: Consumers Energy Electric Lineworker Pre-Apprenticeship Training Program
paths.format: 10-week MCC core curriculum + 11-week Climb School
paths.note: Pre-apprenticeship pathway to Consumers Energy lineworker roles (completion does not guarantee employment).

paths.name: Electric Power Lineworker Apprenticeship Program
paths.format: 4-year program, 96 hours per year over three non-consecutive weeks
paths.note: Related instruction for DOL lineworker apprenticeships; participants must be affiliated with an electric company, cooperative or contractor.

paths.name: Power network craftsperson (Level 3 apprenticeship standard ST0156)
paths.format: Level 3; typically 30-36 months
paths.note: National standard for overhead linesperson, underground cable jointer and substation fitter apprenticeships run by UK network operators.

paths.name: Master's in Power Systems Engineering Online (MEng)
paths.format: Online, 30 graduate credit hours
paths.note: Prepares electrical engineers for utility practice; engineers from other disciplines may succeed with AC circuits and maths background.

paths.name: MSc Electrical Power Systems Engineering
paths.format: 12 months full-time, in person
paths.note: Power systems and high-voltage engineering MSc using Manchester's High Voltage Lab.

paths.name: MSc Electrical Engineering - Electrical Power Engineering track
paths.format: 120 EC, 24 months
paths.note: Track covering power grids, power conversion and high voltage for the energy transition.

paths.name: SINReM - International MSc in Sustainable and Innovative Natural Resource Management
paths.provider: EIT RawMaterials Academy (Ghent University, Uppsala University and partners)
paths.format: EIT-labelled joint master's programme
paths.note: Raw-materials value chain from exploration to materials use and recycling of critical resources.

paths.name: EMerald Master in Georesources Engineering
paths.provider: EIT RawMaterials Academy (University of Liège, Luleå University of Technology, University of Lorraine and partners)
paths.format: EIT-labelled joint master's programme
paths.note: Geometallurgy and circular-economy engineering to address Europe's raw-materials skills shortage.

paths.name: Materials Science and Engineering MSc
paths.format: 1 year full-time, 180 credits; 2:2 or above in engineering/technical subjects
paths.note: Compulsory modules in advanced metallurgy and manufacturing and non-metallic materials, plus a 60-credit research project.

paths.name: Materials Science and Engineering MSc
paths.format: 1 year
paths.note: Advanced metallurgy, metallurgical processing and functional materials incl. electrical transport and magnetic properties.

paths.name: Metallurgical and Materials Engineering (BS, MS, PhD)
paths.format: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes
paths.note: Master's and doctoral specialisations in physical and mechanical metallurgy and physicochemical processing of materials.

paths.name: Werkstoffprüfer/in - Fachrichtung Metalltechnik (Ausbildung)
paths.provider: BIBB (Federal Institute for Vocational Education and Training)
paths.format: Dual apprenticeship, 42 months
paths.note: Materials-testing technician for steelworks, foundries and energy companies: metallography, destructive and non-destructive testing, heat treatment.

paths.name: Nuclear Technology AAS
paths.format: Two-year associate degree
paths.note: Hands-on nuclear operations, nuclear science and radiochemistry, with internships (Oak Ridge region).

paths.name: NEI Uniform Curriculum Program (Nuclear Power Technology)
paths.format: Online programmes and classes offered
paths.note: Industry-approved NUCP curriculum; graduates may be exempted from portions of utilities' initial training.

paths.name: Nuclear Technology
paths.format: Associate degree incl. on-the-job training at a nuclear facility
paths.note: Prepares for entry-level roles with nuclear plant maintenance contractors or utilities, or the nuclear Navy.

paths.name: Capenhurst Apprenticeships
paths.format: 1-4 years; GCSE English and Maths grade 4+
paths.note: Process operations and mechanical/electrical maintenance apprenticeships at a uranium enrichment site, delivered with Training Tomorrow's Engineers.

paths.name: Destination Nuclear
paths.format: Apprenticeships, entry-level roles, graduate schemes and mid-career switch routes
paths.note: Government-funded portal to nuclear careers, including guidance on transferring skills from other industries.

paths.name: Linde student and graduate programmes (LTOP/HYTOP, BOC Graduate Engineering Scheme, Linde Engineering Trainee)
paths.format: e.g. BOC 4-year graduate engineering scheme; 2-year Linde Engineering Trainee Program; LTOP/HYTOP after graduation
paths.note: Structured programmes in industrial-gas plant operations, engineering and hydrogen for new graduates.

paths.name: BCC Advanced Cryogenics Course
paths.format: 3-day in-person course, 6-8 October 2026, STFC Daresbury Laboratory
paths.note: For engineers and scientists with some experience of low-temperature systems; new technician-focused courses planned.

paths.name: Cryogenic Engineering and Safety Courses
paths.format: Annual summer course plus virtual and customer-site courses
paths.note: Technical cryogenic engineering and safety training and consulting.

paths.name: Siemens Mechatronic Systems Certification Program (SMSCP)
paths.format: Three certification levels (Assistant, Associate, Professional) via partner schools
paths.note: Systems-based mechatronics troubleshooting training derived from the German dual system.

paths.name: Ausbildung Mechatroniker (w/m/d)
paths.format: 3.5 years (42 months); paid (min. EUR 1,065.59 gross/month in year 1)
paths.note: Mechanics, sensors, drive systems, automation and 3D printing; maintaining and optimising production systems.

paths.name: FAME Advanced Manufacturing Technician (AMT) program
paths.provider: FAME USA (Federation for Advanced Manufacturing Education)
paths.format: Paid work/study: classes 2 days/week at a community college + at least 24 hours/week at a sponsor; earns an associate degree
paths.note: Earn-and-learn advanced manufacturing / maintenance technician pathway offered in chapters across many US states.

paths.name: SME Certified Additive Manufacturing Technician (CAMT)
paths.format: Certification exam
paths.note: Credential built with America Makes covering the seven AM technologies, processes, material selection and post-processing.

paths.name: Polytech Center (職業能力開発促進センター) job-seeker vocational training
paths.provider: JEED (Japan Organization for Employment of the Elderly, Persons with Disabilities and Job Seekers)
paths.format: Public vocational training for job seekers and in-service workers
paths.note: National public training centres focused on manufacturing (machinery, electrical, electronics) to support re-employment.

paths.name: Datacenter Academy
paths.format: Delivered through partner community colleges and vocational schools; 'Introduction to Datacenters' six-module course
paths.note: Curriculum, donated datacenter labs, mentoring and work-experience opportunities at Microsoft datacenters.

paths.name: Data Center Technician Certificate
paths.format: Certificate
paths.note: Hardware support, server management, data-center processes and preventative maintenance.

paths.name: Data Centre Technician (TU5263), part-time
paths.format: 1 academic year, 3 evenings a week; EUR 3,000 (20 Amazon scholarships); optional 14-week paid Amazon placement
paths.note: Level 6 data-centre operations course; applicants over 23 may be considered on experience; alumni include career changers from other trades.

paths.name: Data Centre Engineering Operations (DCEO) Apprenticeship
paths.format: 36 months, 40-hour week; Level 4 (Electrical Power Protection and Plant Commissioning Engineer); 18+, STEM A Level/BTEC or Level 3 apprenticeship
paths.note: Blended-learning apprenticeship testing and maintaining the electrical power systems that run AWS data centres.

paths.name: Certified Data Center Technician Professional (CDCTP)
paths.format: 5 days; data-center work experience essential
paths.note: Upskilling for working technicians: power, cooling, IT and space constraints, standards and operational procedures.
